description: CONFIRMED SUCCESS (2026-09-26, connection 3 of 3; see docs/probes.md's own dedicated section for the full write-up). Connections 1-2 (work/verify/results/harness-selftest-2026-09-26T{11-57-52-819Z,12-13-00-709Z}.json) found and fixed 3 independent, harness-wide bugs (all now fixed in verify/lib/{batch,clgen}.mjs, not just this manifest): (1) explicit setccsid+STMFCCSID broke CPYFRMSTMF, because heredoc-written files are genuinely EBCDIC (CCSID 273, PUB400's own QCCSID) and forcing an ASCII/1208 tag onto EBCDIC bytes is a real encoding mismatch - fixed by making 'no CCSID handling at all' the harness-wide default (CPYFRMSTMF then correctly trusts the file's own true tag). (2) heredocWrite() appended an extra trailing blank line to every transferred file - RPG III's compiler rejected it as 'Form-Type entry invalid' (QRG2001). (3) PUB400's QDECFMT uses a comma as the decimal point - clgen.mjs's own SUBSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT,1,200) hit this (SQL0104), fixed with a space after each comma. Connection 3 confirmed all three fixes together AND answered this manifest's original question: INQMSGRPY(*DFT) DOES auto-answer RPG0102 (with 'C'/Cancel), turning what would otherwise be an infinite hang into a normal, MONMSG-caught 'RUNIT FAILED' - confirmed directly in the job log (`run` section) and killedForTimeout:false. T0ZERO itself compiled with Highest Severity 00 (9 records, matching its real line count - the trailing-blank-line bug is gone).
